limitations: Evidence commands overlap; do not sum their test counts as unique functional coverage.
Legacy fixture failures caused by stronger focus/selection receipts were handed to the validation member; final E1 includes their compatible updates, not weaker production checks.
No real installed GUI refresh, build, packaging, publishing, profile deletion, download, upload, account login, authorization, clipboard or desktop input.
Some existing test names say end-to-end or full; their fixture mechanism, not their title, defines evidence strength.
Source reviews and ownership handoffs do not count as runtime passed paths.
